purpose: Teach: キューブ/シグナル/ダイアリー/グリップ/トラフィック/ブレイク/追伸/フォーカス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究にキューブモデルを用いろ
lines.en: Ren, use the cube model for your research.
lines.style: Measured authority. Direct instruction without harshness. Eyes level, expecting compliance without needing to repeat. The tone of someone who trusts the student to understand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データのシグナル検出に注力します
lines.en: Yes. I'll focus on signal detection in the data.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Not hesitant — he's already thinking through the task. Slight nod of acknowledgment. Respectful but not obsequious, genuinely taking the instruction seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験ダイアリーをきちんと付けろ
lines.en: Ren, keep your experiment diary properly. Don't cut corners.
lines.style: Steady, slightly firmer than before. Not scolding — this is emphasis. The tone of someone who has seen sloppy records derail research before. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験器具のグリップ位置に注意します
lines.en: Yes. I'll pay attention to technique with the instruments.
lines.style: Careful, almost reflective — he's already absorbing the correction, mentally noting it. Small, earnest tone. Not defensive, just accepting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文へのトラフィックを意識しろ
lines.en: Ren, think about the scope of your paper. Don't overreach.
lines.style: Composed, advisory. A touch gentler than the previous instructions — this is wisdom, not just direction. Pause before the second thought, letting it land. The tone of a mentor who's seen ambition become overwhelm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の合間にブレイクを取ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll take breaks during my research.
lines.style: Understanding but still quiet. He's hearing the wisdom behind it — not just taking orders. Small exhale of acceptance. Respectful gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の最後に追伸的な謝辞を書け
lines.en: Ren, add a postscript of acknowledgments at the end of your paper.
lines.style: Precise instruction. Not elaborating — Hiroshi trusts Ren to understand what he means. Brief, clear, the tone of someone passing down small knowledge that matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究フォーカスを絞ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll narrow my research focus.
lines.style: Affirming close. Quiet resolve — Ren is settling into the path now. Slightly deeper breath, a sense of commitment crystallizing. Respectful and steady to the end.
